reuse.why: Turns the hidden-category query the three average actions already shared by copy into one selector and reuses it in setZero and copyPreviousMonth; the saved-template test uses the same goal_def column goal-template relies on.

duplication.why: Removes the three query copies and the inline hidden check; the per-action income/tracking check is left repeated as it was.

placement.why: The selector sits in budget/actions.ts next to getBudgetData and the actions that use it.

scope.why: Only the five month-wide actions, the selector and tests change.

maintainability.why: Which categories month-wide actions may touch is one commented query; the income rule still lives in each action, so the selection is split across two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg all take their categories from getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The old query copies are removed; nothing is reshaped.

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts getMonthWideCategories holds the hidden, hidden-group and saved-template rule for every month-wide action (the unchanged income rule stays per action).
